C3.reason: Pinned GBNF failed the pre-declared capability gate (30/70 envelopes; 246/300 gold reachable; 120/6696 invalid witnesses accepted) and shares key-order restriction, so it cannot inform either co-primary contrast. No substitute or subset run.
C3.finding_kind: model-free engine finding, not E0b inference

amendments.reason: Pinned GBNF failed the pre-declared capability gate (30/70 envelopes; 246/300 gold reachable; 120/6696 invalid witnesses accepted) and shares key-order restriction, so it cannot inform either co-primary contrast. No substitute or subset run.

amendments.timing: before any determinism or benchmark inference
amendments.reason: Smoke treated legal-prefix truncation as infrastructure fault; cd_truncated is a model outcome. Seven C1/C2 smoke outputs on benchmark units were observed; no analysis decision rule changed.

amendments.timing: before any determinism or benchmark inference

resource_policy.warnings: memory pressure, non-nominal thermal, sustained swap rate
resource_policy.resume: resource stops only; completed keys never re-sent; frozen order; timestamps; no accuracy reads
resource_policy.hard_stop: system swapout growth > 1 GiB; engine/request fault; constraint violation; illegal-prefix truncation; determinism mismatch

amendments.justification: Greedy decoding with a fixed seed and independent requests makes resource-driven pause/resume timing outcome-independent; no accuracy is read between segments. Fixed seed and greedy decoding do not establish byte-identical execution across server restarts; the frozen determinism gate remains required and is not reset or re-run on resume.

smoke_pass_rule: HTTP200 and no fresh engine error and (finished strict JSON valid under constraint copy and named raw schema OR length with native legal-prefix proof)
